hero.text: A library that stays yours: on your computer, or on a server you choose.

heading: How do you want to start?
subheading: You can change your mind later in the settings.

back.title: Welcome back to {library}
back.localText: The library lives on this computer.
back.openFailed: I can't open the library: the access saved on this computer is no longer valid.

forget.title: Forget this library?
forget.text: {library} will disappear from this computer. The books stay where they are: you can reconnect it later.

local.title: Create here
local.text: The library lives on this computer. Nothing else needed.
local.openText: There is already a library on this computer.
local.openFailed: I can't open the library: the access saved on this computer is no longer valid.

join.title: Join
join.text: Connect this computer to a library that already exists.
join.mode: How do you want to sign in
join.chooseTitle: Which library do you want to enter?
join.needsSetup: This server has no library yet. You can create it from the “Create on a server” card.

server.title: Create on a server
server.text: To reach it from your phone too, away from home.
server.alreadySet: This server already has a library. To get in, use the “Join” card.

fields.codeHint: You find it in the devices settings, on a device that is already connected.
fields.setupCodeHint: The server shows it the first time it starts.

probe.insecure: This address is not secure. Use an address that starts with https://, or an address on your home network.
probe.network: I can't reach the server. Check the address and your connection, then try again.
probe.notBookeeper: Something answers at this address, but it is not a Bookeeper server.

phrase.title: Check the phrase
phrase.text: This computer does not know this server's certificate. These six words must match the ones the server shows.

errors.email: Enter a valid email address, with the @.
errors.passwordShort: The password must have at least {min} characters.
errors.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.rateLimitedNoTime: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.validation: Some data is not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.setupClosed: This server already has a library.
errors.network: I can't reach the library. Check your connection and try again.
errors.libraryChoice: This account belongs to several libraries. Sign in from “Join” with email and password and pick one.
errors.generic: The operation could not be completed. Try again; if it keeps happening, check that the server is running.
errors.genericLocal: The operation could not be completed on this computer. Try again; if it keeps happening, close and reopen Bookeeper.
